extension.disclaimer: This add-on is not supported by Plex
Este add-on no está respaldado por Plex
Dieses Addon wird nicht von der Firma Plex Inc. unterstützt
extension.news: - Detail screens: improve clear-logo sizing and alignment, with text titles for overly square logos - Episodes: tidy headings, date formats, summary spacing and resume indicators - Home: preserve distinct hubs with similar identifiers and correctly label hubs from other libraries - Watchlist: handle rate limits with retries and cooldowns - Watchlist: fix premature removal after manual watched-state changes and cleanup after autoplay - Playback: keep the interface responsive while synchronizing progress and watched status after playback - Playback: fix season refreshes and episode lists after playback - Player: prevent spoiler titles and time information flashing at playback start - Player: fix autoplay initialization, skip-marker timing and playback controls between episodes - Player: keep Kodi's playback chooser visible during initial seeks - Player: fix blackout cleanup and stale callbacks after stopping or abandoning playback - Core: release closed playback windows and discard abandoned background callbacks - Core: handle missing list-item artwork - Xbox: fix startup failure after recent system updates - CoreELEC/p3i: improve skip-marker OSD signalling and playback initialization; skip automatic detection for Direct Streaming and transcoding
